title: Factory agent turn result
description: Written by the agent to .agent/out/result.json at the end of every design or build turn.

status.description: ready_for_review: the turn finished the work. blocked (design) / question (build): a human must answer before continuing. continue: more turns needed. failed: the turn could not complete.

summary.description: First line becomes the commit message subject. Always required.

context.description: One or two lines of background for the Jira comment: why this shape, and where to read the detail. Not a restatement of summary.

criterion.description: What must be true when the card is done. An outcome a reviewer can agree or disagree with, not an action and not an implementation detail.

steps.description: The exact browser actions that prove this one criterion, in order, with the app already open. The last one is an observation, not an action.

acceptance_criteria.description: The acceptance criteria, each paired with the steps that prove it. Required when status is ready_for_review.

artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths this turn produced or changed.

questions.description: Required when status is blocked or question.

assumptions.description: Decisions taken without asking. Surfaced on the PR and the Jira card.
